description: Irma Basemap - Florida Transportation Data is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by (deposited on HydroShare). This resource contains statewide networks of roadways, bridges, and railway crossings, for Florida only. These datasets were obtained from Florida Dept of Transportation (FDOT) in August 2018 via their website [1]. The FDOT GIS data is continually being updated, so if you wish to find the most complete and current data, please visit that site. Coverage: Florida, United States. The resource was created 2018-08-10 and last updated 2026-01-29; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
